name: Aloo Ke Gutke
instructions: 1. Heat mustard oil in an iron kadhai until it smokes, then reduce the heat.
2. Add cumin seeds, mustard seeds, and dried red chillies, letting them crackle.
3. Add asafoetida, then stir in the turmeric powder.
4. Add the boiled potato cubes and toss gently to coat them with the spices.
5. Sprinkle salt and crushed coriander seeds over the potatoes.
6. Sauté on medium-low heat for 8-10 minutes until the potatoes develop a light, crispy golden crust.
7. Garnish generously with fresh coriander leaves and serve hot.
description: Aloo Ke Gutke is the most famous snack from the Kumaon region of Uttarakhand. It is a simple yet flavorful dish often served with hot tea or as a side with Poori or Mandua (finger millet) roti. It is a staple at local festivities and roadside dhabas across the hills.
